summary: The plugin subsystem is the extensibility backbone of Barkpark: a GenServer-backed registry, a resolver-chain dispatcher, and a suite of concrete plugins (Bulldocs, Sheets, OnixEdit, Tasks, Media, FRT) that add domain-specific schemas, routes, workers, and lifecycle hooks without touching the core CMS kernel.

intentions.title: Enable zero-coupling feature extensions via a plugin highway
intentions.evidence: registry.ex discover_and_register + resolve_module, bulldocs.ex register_routes/1, manifest.ex compile-time JSON Schema validation, bootstrap.ex schema installer — together these form a self-describing plugin contract (plugin.json → module → routes → schemas) that lets new document surfaces land without editing core router or migration files

intentions.title: Guarantee a working system with all plugins disabled (fresh-install invariant)
intentions.evidence: registry.ex Application.get_env(:barkpark, :plugins, []) kill-switch, discover_and_register/0 explicit-empty short-circuit, plugin_free_boot_test.exs references throughout, Bulldocs/Sheets moduledocs explicitly state 'core keeps the reusable machinery, plugin is thin wiring'

intentions.title: Expose self-describing CLI and API capabilities per caller auth tier
intentions.evidence: capabilities.ex assembles /v1/capabilities manifest from core_commands + collect_cli_commands, projects it through a default-deny existence-hiding filter (visible?/2, project/2) keyed on six auth tiers (none < read < write < admin, plus scoped_admin + ingest side channels), emitting per-tier ETags

intentions.title: Thread plugin contributions through an ordered, fault-isolated resolver chain
intentions.evidence: registry.ex reduce_resolvers/3 drives 11 resolver callbacks (action_handlers, desk_items, doc_actions, extract_edges, cli_commands, api_tests, …) in Application-config load order; every call wrapped in safe_call / safe_resolver_call so a crashing plugin returns prev, never aborts the chain; persistent_term snapshot for hot-path zero-arg reads

intentions.title: Intercept and gate document lifecycle events across plugins
intentions.evidence: hooks.ex fires before_save/publish/unpublish/delete sequentially (first {:halt, reason} cancels mutation) and after_* events concurrently via Task.async_stream with 5s timeout + slow-hook telemetry warnings; sheets.ex uses before_save to validate A1 keys + grid-bounds before any mutate reaches Postgres

intentions.title: Persist and audit plugin secrets encrypted at rest
intentions.evidence: settings.ex + settings_record.ex (Cloak encryption) + settings_audit.ex — every get/put/delete writes an audit row in an atomic transaction; settings/masking.ex masks values for display; telemetry emitted on read/write

intentions.title: Expose plugin-contributed document types with content-graph edge extraction
intentions.evidence: bulldocs.ex register_schemas + graph edge extraction (resolve_extract_edges chain in registry.ex), sheets.ex register_schemas, onixedit.ex — plugins declare schemas that bootstrap.ex upserts idempotently on every boot, and each plugin can contribute content-graph edges per-document via resolve_extract_edges/2

intentions.title: Support per-plugin background workers and Oban cron jobs
intentions.evidence: registry.ex collect_workers/1 and collect_oban_crontab/0 run synchronously before the supervision tree starts, fold plugin-declared child specs and crontab entries into Application.start/2 before Oban begins — plugins gain scheduled jobs without any core Oban config change

intentions.title: Provide declarative smoke-test specs that any plugin can contribute
intentions.evidence: registry.ex collect_api_tests/1 + media/api_tests.ex — plugins export api_tests/0 returning typed test-spec maps the admin runner fires; resolver chain lets plugins filter or reorder sibling specs
